html.htmlText: Beautifully Brownstone-designed Studio apartment features 1 Queen-size bed and a pullout sofa bed located right off Grand Central Metro Station. Walking distance to Times Square, Steps from Central Park & the Metropolitan Museum of Art. surrounded by cool bars, restaurants, and coffee places. Located next to the United Nations, therefore, one of the safest neighborhoods in NYC. The apartment is well-designed and features anything you need for your trip, linens, towels, pots, pans, fridge, etc.

Please be advised that there is ongoing construction in the vicinity of the property. Work typically takes place Monday through Friday, from 7:30 AM to 5:00 PM, and may occasionally cause noise disruptions during those hours.

We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and appreciate your understanding as the neighborhood continues to grow and improve. Earplugs are provided in the unit for your comfort.

If you have any questions or concerns during your stay, feel free to reach out — we’re here to help!
